name: local-mods

plugins.name: context-forecast
plugins.description: Context window forecast with a clear-or-compact score, usage limits and guided compaction.

plugins.name: lean-context
plugins.description: Measures and optionally strips configured sections of the project instruction file from the context while no spec is active.

plugins.name: spec-band
plugins.description: Band above the prompt with the active spec of the branch: STATE.md age, phase and a stale-STATE warning.

plugins.name: env-doctor
plugins.description: Read-only dev environment preflight: stopped compose services, missing node_modules, empty cache files.

plugins.name: graph-sync
plugins.description: Refreshes the code knowledge graph in the background after edits (AST-only update command).

plugins.name: session-banner
plugins.description: Gradient ASCII logo with a shimmer once at the start of each session, read from a plain text file.

description: Personal Claude Code mods: context forecast, lean context, spec band, env doctor, graph sync and a session banner.
